limitations.note: The continuous assignment fixed the broken output driver, but replacing the falling-edge count logic with a copy of `clkp` delayed both divide-by-7 output transitions by half an input cycle.
The test checked transition spacing and accepted either input edge, so it passed without checking which edge should produce each transition or when the first transition should occur after reset.

limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire simulation invocation to be rejected, so the agent had to resubmit the test.
Testing the newly added divide-by-one bypass stopped the simulation and prompted a reset-stimulus change that did not help verify the requested divide-by-7 waveform.
